units.source_text: “因此啊，奶奶都是因为有你这个指望才能活得下去。

en.t: So you see, Grandma can go on living only because she has you to hope for.

units.source_text: 你很快就十七岁了，到那时候一定要早点娶媳妇进门，奶奶才可以享享清福。

en.t: You will soon be seventeen, and by then you must hurry and bring a wife into the house so Grandma can finally enjoy some ease.

units.source_text: 你母亲还说什么要等到你当兵回来之后再娶亲，说的到轻松简单。

en.t: Your mother says you should wait until you come back from being a soldier before marrying, but that is easy enough for her to say.

units.source_text: 为什么，为什么要等当兵之后！

en.t: Why, why should you have to wait until after you become a soldier!
Do you understand what I am saying?

units.source_text: 你要孝顺奶奶，连你父亲的那份一起孝顺奶奶喔！

en.t: You must be good to Grandma, and you must be good to her for your father's share too!

units.source_text: 这样，奶奶也会很疼爱你，什么都留给你。”

en.t: Then Grandma will love you dearly too, and she will leave everything to you.
